top.title: Hi. We're bengUSA.pro.
top.line: We build apps that mind their own business.

story.heading: Our story
story.text: We build software for a living. Rob made TimeTracker to turn his own hours into invoices. He's building Vault (working name) to sort his own server keys. Now we're making them for you.

list.name: Rob Guida
list.title: Co-founder & CEO
list.bio: He has built software and led development teams for more than 30 years. He designs systems, rescues stuck projects and helps teams choose what to build and what to buy. His tools: AWS, SQL, Node.js, GraphQL, React, Python, Rust and PHP.
list.alt: Rob Guida, in glasses, a gray jacket and a light-blue shirt, against a dark blue background.

list.name: Fojle Rabbi Saikat
list.title: Co-founder & CTO
list.bio: He has been a software engineer since 2015 and has shipped more than 30 Android apps on Google Play. He designs system architecture, leads teams and builds with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Laravel, Node.js, Vue.js, PostgreSQL and MySQL. He also built the original code for this site.
list.alt: Fojle Rabbi Saikat, in glasses and a navy kurta, sitting on a black scooter outdoors.
